pages.description: A list of the pages in the book.

raw.description: The text component representing the text content of the page.

filtered.description: The Text component representing the filtered text of the page. Optional. Shown only to players with chat filter enabled, instead of text.

title.description: The title of this written book.

filtered.description: The filtered title. Optional. Shown only to players with chat filter enabled, instead of {{nbt|string|text}}.

author.description: The author of this written book.

generation.description: The number of times this written book has been copied. 0 = original, 1 = copy of original, 2 = copy of copy, 3 = tattered. Defaults to 0. If the value is greater than 1, the book cannot be copied.

resolved.description: If {{cd|true}}, the text components have already been resolved (such as entity selectors and scores). If {{cd|false}}, they are resolved when this book is opened by a player for the first time. Defaults to {{cd|false}}.

written_book_content.description: The contents and metadata of this [ [written book] ].
